articles.title: Mumbai: BMC Seeks Alternate Financing To Fund Mega Projects Amid ₹2 Lakh Crore In Committed Liabilities
articles.description: The BMC has invited tenders to appoint an agency to mobilise alternate financing as committed liabilities exceed ₹2 lakh crore and major infrastructure projects remain underway. The agency will prepare a capital investment plan and debt policy and explore bonds, carbon finance, government schemes and blended funding. About ₹39,500 crore of reserves is currently available for infrastructure.

articles.title: British premier defends sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements in West Bank
articles.description: British Premier Andy Burnham has called for action over illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank, warning that failure to act could further undermine trust in politics and make a two-state solution non-viable, Anadolu reports. Speaking to reporters alongside US President Donald Trump in New York, Burnham said there could be a point at which the expansion of settlements posed a direct challenge to the prospects for a two-state solution. “If we face a situation where there’s a tender to put settlements on the West Bank that, in effect, make a two-state solution non-viable, what do we do?” he said. articles.title: Demolition of Shastri Bhavan, Krishi Bhavan to begin soon; CPWD asks ministries to vacate by September-end
articles.description: The CPWD, in a recent note, communicated to the ministries and departments that the tender for the construction of Kartavya Bhavan 4 and 5 at plots where the two office blocks stand had already been awarded.
